description: Show the blocks (sections) of a site page with their captions — the FIRST step of a targeted site edit. The user picks a block from the LIST (there are 6-8). If editable=false, the page CANNOT be edited this way — tell the user so honestly and offer a regeneration; do NOT pretend the change happened. Returns page_checksum — pass it to edit_site_block.

page_id.description: Optional — the site's home page is taken

portal_id.description: Optional — the portal with the site is taken

name: list_site_blocks
